2116590796619304994.en_summary: Jason Calacanis Identifies AI’s Biggest Opportunity: Adoption Is Still Nascent At Work. Gallup survey shows frequent vs daily AI use at work still 10-20%. Top enterprises not allowing unconstrained use or connecting email/knowledge bases due to cyber fears. Once cyber mitigated, daily users could go from 10% to 60-80%. Uber bought ChatGPT for every employee as example.
2116590796619304994.zh_summary: Jason Calacanis 指出 AI 最大機會：工作場所採用仍處於早期。Gallup 調查顯示工作中頻繁與每日使用 AI 仍為 10-20%。頂級企業因網路安全恐懼不允許無約束使用或連接電子郵件/知識庫。一旦網路威脅緩解，每日用戶可能從 10% 升至 60-80%。Uber 為每位員工購買 ChatGPT 為例。
